scripts._clean: rm -rf test-results playwright-report allure-results allure-report FAILED playwright/.auth
scripts._zap_clean: mkdir -p zap-report && rm -rf zap-report/*.json zap-report/*.html zap-report/playwright-report && : > zap-report/zap.log
scripts._zap_clean_and_test_docker_compose: npm run _zap_clean && npm run _clean && npm run _zap_prime_context && npm run _test_docker_compose --
scripts.test:security: npm run _zap_clean && npm run _zap_prime_context && npm run _clean_and_test -- --grep-invert '@compose|@a11y|@visual|@active|@dynamics' --timeout=60000
scripts.test:security:active: npm run _zap_clean && npm run _zap_prime_context && npm run _clean_and_test -- --grep '@active' --timeout=60000
scripts.test:browserstack: echo 'BrowserStack Playwright tests not implemented yet'
scripts.test:docker-compose:security: export PROFILE=security && npm run _test_docker_compose_security && npm run _zap_run_and_gate
scripts.test:docker-compose:security:active: export PROFILE=security:active && npm run _test_docker_compose_security_active && npm run _zap_run_and_gate
scripts.test:docker-compose:animals:security: export PROFILE=security && npm run _test_docker_compose_security -- tests/animals/ && npm run _zap_run_and_gate
scripts.test:docker-compose:animals:security:act: export PROFILE=security:active ZAP_SCOPE=animals && npm run _test_docker_compose_security_active -- tests/animals/ && npm run _zap_run_and_gate
scripts.test:docker-compose:animals-admin:securi: export PROFILE=security && npm run _test_docker_compose_security -- tests/animals-admin/ && npm run _zap_run_and_gate
export PROFILE=security:active ZAP_SCOPE=animals-admin && npm run _test_docker_compose_security_active -- tests/animals-admin/ && npm run _zap_run_and_gate
scripts.test:docker-compose:ins:security: export PROFILE=security && npm run _test_docker_compose_security -- tests/ins/ && npm run _zap_run_and_gate
scripts.test:docker-compose:ins:security:active: export PROFILE=security:active ZAP_SCOPE=ins && npm run _test_docker_compose_security_active -- tests/ins/ && npm run _zap_run_and_gate
